conditions.evidence: Crown and outer upper sides keep a contiguous coffee-brown region between narrow reflections.
A broad neutral silver inner section begins below the lifted brown hair near the visible ear and runs toward shoulder-level ends; it is a separate colored layer.
The lifted brown edge and adjacent brown strands visibly overlap the silver inner region at the near ear.
Fine separated crown strands and controlled narrow satin reflections support the specified dry-looking finish; this is an appearance judgment, not a physical moisture measurement.

The lower lengths form compact groups and have tiny bright end highlights. From the complete native image I cannot reliably establish water-bead shape at several ends of both colored layers or the specified restriction to only the lower few centimeters; rain on the window and wet fabric do not count as hair evidence.

scope: This judges the frozen C test; it does not qualify the entire hair dataset or infer reference identity.
